title: Domain authors write typed functions, not adapters

nodes.summary: Authors write plain typed modules; Kyyn generates adapters and codecs
nodes.detail: The authored surface is ordinary MicroHs schema/code modules, generated bindings, pure functions and explicit capability operations. Kyyn generates entry adapters, codecs, transport and registration wrappers; no authored main, manual JSON/Dhall decoding, response IDs or runtime paths.

realised.evidence: PR #12 evaluates named schema metadata through a generated guest entry; validation (#25) and query (#27) entries follow the same pattern

deliveries.evidence: PR #6 generates JSON codecs from compiler-inspected authored ADTs; generated entry adapters follow in #12

nodes.summary: Three KB entry kinds: Query, Evolution, Validation
nodes.detail: KB code has exactly three entry-point kinds; a report is a query result, evaluating a workspace is not a fourth model, and plugin methods are integration operations, not entry kinds. An evolution returns a root that Kyyn turns into a candidate; it never calls a nested propose or self-accepts.

realised.evidence: Validation executed at seq 24, queries at seq 26, evolution workspaces evaluated into candidates at seq 34 (PR #35)

deliveries.evidence: PR #25 executes Validation entries; Query (#27) and Evolution (#35) entries still missing
PR #27 adds Query entries; Evolution workspaces are evaluated into candidates only in #35

nodes.summary: Output renderers are pure snapshot computations; host invokes sinks
nodes.detail: An output declaration binds an ordinary renderer function to a typed plugin sink. Rendering is selected-snapshot computation like a query, possibly composing queries; generated adapters prepare values and a separate host operation invokes the sink.

realised.evidence: No renderer/output/sink code exists in kyyn-v2 at end of history

nodes.summary: One `evolution` binding per workspace; arguments bound in source
nodes.detail: Each evolution workspace exposes a single `evolution` binding, with helper selection and arguments written in source (e.g. `evolution = importSales September`), so evaluation needs no named-entry/arguments manifest.

realised.evidence: Conventional evolution binding prepared and evaluated in PR #35 (cf. 0010.10)

deliveries.evidence: PR #33 workspace creation emits a typechecked conventional `evolution` binding; preparing and evaluating it follows in #35

nodes.summary: Authors export pure SchemaMetadata assigning roles to real fields
nodes.detail: Alongside the schema, authors export a pure SchemaMetadata value attaching KB-defined roles, collection identities and reference targets to actual fields; the host uses it for titles/timelines/badges without knowing the domain. Names are validated against extracted declarations.

realised.evidence: SchemaMetadata code_added at seq 11 (PR #12 evaluates named Haskell schema metadata); checked with structure at seq 12

nodes.summary: One plugin package registers checked methods under connector types
nodes.detail: Registration binds a name and description to an implementation with checked contracts and capability requirements; fixed plugin functions coexist with discovered domain methods. Related connector methods live in one source-distributed plugin package, and named instances of a connector type share code but not configuration or identity.

realised.evidence: PR #100 registers source connectors and validates root-owned instance configuration; plugin packages installed from source at seq 72-74

deliveries.evidence: PRs #87/#89/#90 make plugin packages source-distributed and installable; connector registration with checked contracts and named instances follows in #100

nodes.summary: Generated Method handles typecheck registerMethod implementations
nodes.detail: In the guest API a generated, constructor-private `Method requests input output` fixes types and request algebra, so `registerMethod` cannot attach an unrelated function; RegisteredMethod hides the types only after the check.

realised.evidence: registerMethod/RegisteredMethod never appear in code; tools use a kb.dhall registry (seq 87) and plugins signature-derived registration (seq 116), yet the ADR still shows this API

nodes.summary: Host sees structural descriptors; queries resolve by root-local name
nodes.detail: The host uses MethodDescriptor/QueryDescriptor with checked input/output contracts rather than Haskell types. A query is a root-local name plus contract, resolved in the selected root's code at execution and compared, so saved examples test revised implementations without pinning old code.

realised.evidence: QueryDescriptor and contract checks at invocation in PR #27; saved examples compare contract fingerprints in #28. MethodDescriptor/MethodIdentity never implemented

nodes.summary: KB helpers call generated typed plugin proxies; provider parsing stays in plugin
nodes.detail: KB code calls generated bindings with concrete input/output types that route through the host and the plugin's own capability context; provider JSON interpretation belongs inside the plugin, never the KB.

realised.evidence: PR #107 generates phantom-typed instance handles and concrete read proxies importing real plugin types

deliveries.evidence: PR #106 adds typed plugin-side captured-read methods that own payload interpretation, invoked through the host; generated KB-side proxies follow in #107

nodes.summary: Small SDK; reuse existing libraries and mechanically generated optics
nodes.detail: Provide a small SDK for identified facts, diagnostics, exact-value adapters and evolution composition; do not build a Kyyn arithmetic library or grow custom optics in place of evaluating dependencies. Keep After imports qualified and generate record field optics mechanically.

realised.evidence: Optics code_added at seq 55 with generated collection handles and field optics (cf. 0010.45)

deliveries.evidence: PR #33 adds the small SDK's evolution composition; generated record field optics follow in #64

nodes.summary: Queries registered in kb.dhall; generated KyynQueryBindings with Query alias
nodes.detail: Queries are `args -> Query result` over generated collection bindings, registered as a `queries` list in kb.dhall naming qualified Haskell exports (not repeated structural types) with explicit metadata exports. Kyyn inspects schema first, then generates KyynQueryBindings; schema modules must not depend on it and collisions are diagnostics.

realised.evidence: PR #27 implements generated bindings, query adapter, discovery and execution

nodes.summary: Query execution alone cannot mint a Validated Root
nodes.detail: RootExecution takes only structurally checked roots; the Validated Root wrapper is reserved for the required-example validation gate in ADR 0011.

realised.evidence: Negative constraint; no Validated wrapper existed in code at seq 26 so execution conformed

nodes.summary: checkRoot alone produces Validated Root; surfaces browse through it
nodes.detail: ADR 0011's checkRoot produces Validated Root after code, semantic and example checks; RootExecution still evaluates unvalidated candidates. CLI/Web/MCP browsing must use the validated boundary, not raw checking.

realised.evidence: PR #28: only checking code constructs the private Validated wrapper; Validated code_added seq 27

nodes.summary: Author API grouped into concept facades over existing definitions
nodes.detail: The installed SDK exposes concept facades (Kyyn.Schema, Validation, Query, Evolution, Edit, Optics) reexporting existing definitions, with execution internals kept out; the discovery catalogue derives only from kyyn-sdk's facade list.

realised.evidence: PR #77 adds the six facades and moves scaffolds/examples to concept imports

nodes.summary: KB tools: a fourth entry kind composing captured-evidence reads
nodes.detail: Adds the KB tool entry point: authored functions composing plugin methods over captured evidence (optionally selected-root reads) for agent investigation, registered with checked contracts, without acquisition, sink calls or root mutation. Queries, validators and renderers gain no plugin access.
sections: Decision / Proposed addition: composed KB investigation tools

realised.evidence: PR #107 composes captured plugin reads in registered KB tools with root tool list/show/execute

nodes.summary: Generated KyynPluginBindings with Acquisition and CapturedRead aliases
nodes.detail: Plugin entries get generated KyynPluginBindings: acquisition entries an Acquisition alias with filesystem/evidence helpers, captured readers a CapturedRead alias with evidence helpers only, injecting requests into the capability sum without exposing codecs. Kyyn.Plugin joins the author facades.

realised.evidence: PR #96 generates acquisition/captured-read bindings and proves them under GHC and MicroHs

nodes.summary: Generated bindings reexport acquisition vocabulary, not registration declarations
nodes.detail: Generated plugin bindings reexport Program, EvidenceSnapshot, FetchError, EvidenceId, Evidence and EvidenceChange; SourceConnector and its fields come only via the plugin entry module's direct Kyyn.Plugin import.

realised.evidence: PR #102 (879424a): generated acquisition bindings no longer reexport registration selectors

nodes.summary: Tools registered in kb.dhall; bindings import plugins' real types
nodes.detail: KB tools are a `tools` list beside `queries` in kb.dhall naming qualified exports; whole-root checking compiles them without invoking. Generated caller bindings import plugins' actual contract-bearing modules rather than structural copies, and module-path conflicts are reported.

realised.evidence: PR #107 implements the tools registry, generated proxies and CLI invocation

nodes.summary: Recipes guide agents; SDK exposes acknowledgement vocabulary
nodes.detail: Recipes (owned by ADR 0014) are not executable registry entries; agents investigate with queries/tools then prepare an evolution following the recipe, using generated acknowledgement helpers without register or fingerprint plumbing.

realised.evidence: Acknowledgement declarations carried in evolution output from seq 92 (cf. 0014.30, 0010.48)

nodes.summary: Kyyn.Evolution carries the KnowledgeBase/recipe vocabulary
nodes.detail: The evolution facade exposes the guest KnowledgeBase wrapper and recipe vocabulary so recipes are edited with the same evolution/edit vocabulary as domain facts.

realised.evidence: First-class recipes in typed evolutions implemented at seq 96 (cf. 0010.49)

deliveries.evidence: PR #117 reexports KnowledgeBase and Recipe editing values through Kyyn.Evolution; host integration and generated handles follow in #118

nodes.summary: Evolution entry follows ADR 0010's pure transformation contract
nodes.detail: The Evolution entry no longer uses declared capabilities to obtain inputs; it produces a candidate through a pure transformation, with investigation happening beforehand in tools.

realised.evidence: Evolution execution was only ever Program NoRequests from PR #35 (cf. 0010.51)

nodes.summary: KB tools compose captured evidence and model judgements, not root reads
nodes.detail: The tool row loses its 'proposed' status and the optional SnapshotRead of the selected root; tools now compose captured-evidence reads and ADR 0027 model judgements, still without acquisition, sinks or root mutation.

realised.evidence: Judgement calls in KB tools implemented in the next PR (cf. 0027.01)

nodes.summary: Plugins import Kyyn.Plugin.Host; contracts derived from authored signatures
nodes.detail: The generated per-entry KyynPluginBindings author route is retired: plugins import Kyyn.Plugin for registration/data and Kyyn.Plugin.Host for payload-parameterized capabilities, and the compiler derives contracts from ordinary signatures. Private generated adapters supply only codecs/transport.

realised.evidence: Kyyn/Plugin/Host.hs from seq 112; PR #151 implements signature-derived plugin registration

nodes.summary: Facades add Kyyn.Plugin.Host, Kyyn.Recipe and Kyyn.Evolution.Proposal
nodes.detail: The concept-grouped author API is no longer a fixed count and includes plugin host capabilities, recipe inputs and declarative fact-edit proposals.

realised.evidence: Plugin/Host.hs at seq 112, Evolution/Proposal.hs at seq 124, Kyyn/Recipe.hs at seq 130

nodes.summary: Recipe-based evolutions propose fact edits plus next typed state
nodes.detail: Recipes own typed state; after investigating with tools an agent prepares a recipe-based evolution containing fact edits and the next state, with generated bindings exposing that state without Dhall or protocol plumbing.

realised.evidence: PR #210 implements typed per-recipe state creation and migration (cf. 0014.57)

deliveries.evidence: PR #208 adds SDK RecipeEdit/RecipeEvolution over facts plus one typed state; persistence and generated state bindings follow in #210

editorial.note: Also drops status/date metadata and the 'surface wrappers not implemented yet' remark: desired-state cleanup with no architectural change
Example tool types switch String to Text to match the packed-Text SDK; illustration only

notes: Two founding guest APIs were never built yet are still in the ADR: the generated Method handle with registerMethod/RegisteredMethod (0008.07) and the host MethodDescriptor/MethodIdentity (half of 0008.08). Tools ended up registered in kb.dhall (seq 87) and plugins through signature-derived registration (seq 116), so the ADR text describes a registration API the code never used. The output/renderer commitment (0008.03) is also entirely unrealised. The plugin-authoring route went round in a circle: seq 78 introduced generated per-entry KyynPluginBindings, seq 83 tightened them, then code moved to a hand-written Kyyn.Plugin.Host with signature-derived contracts (seq 112-116) and the ADR caught up only in the seq 143 reconcile. The KB-tool entry kind (seq 76) contradicts the founding 'three entry kinds, no fourth model' wording; I recorded it as a refine of 0008.02 instead of a replace because the other three kinds remain. Seq 97 (pure evolution) is treated as code_first because evolution execution was never effectful. Several decisions arrived in parts: entry kinds one by one (validation 24, queries 26, evolutions 34).
